messages:
Nora (AE): AuroraEdge CTO just escalated. POC blocked: Okta SSO failing with audience mismatch, p95 spikes when clients send mixed short/long prompts, and procurement wants a 30-day pilot price instead of annual. They want an exec bridge today.

Diego (Presales): I'll own pricing. Need their expected tokens/day and peak RPS to model a 30-day pilot v. a convertible commit.

Sam (SRE): Quick triage: audience mismatch looks like SP metadata mismatch. For perf, KV cache churn when seq > 1k. I can run a 15m canary with kv-prefetch and kv-window adjust. Need sanitized prompts.

Rita (Security): For procurement: send SOC2 + KMS attestation. If they want BYO-KMS we'll need a DPA addendum. Also request their IdP metadata XML and a redacted SAML response to speed debugging.

Hugo (Legal): We can fast-track a scoped DPA for a pilot. If they require HSM-backed keys or on-prem custody, flag now so I can loop counsel.

BridgeBot: Bridge created: BR-14921. Propose 16:30 PT. Use /bridge confirm to update attendees.

Nora (AE): Owners: Diego=pricing; Sam=perf + canary; Rita=security artifacts; Hugo=DPA. One-liner for invite?

Diego (Presales): One-liner: "Run a short canary with long-context optimizations, complete SSO metadata exchange, and present a 30-day pilot pricing to close the POC."

Sam (SRE): Starting canary (kv-prefetch + kv-window 2048) on a 2-node pool: `./run_perf --target https://poc.aurora.redwood/generate --concurrency 80 --seq-mix short:60,long:40 --kv-prefetch --kv-window 2048` Will post results in ~12m.

Rita (Security): Uploading artifacts: SOC2 link and KMS attestation: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/soc2-2025.pdf, https://vault.redwood/artifacts/kms-attest.pdf. Asking AuroraEdge for IdP metadata now.

Sam (SRE): Canary tail: [2026-03-23T20:12Z] run=prf-421 p95=720ms kv_miss=24% ; [2026-03-23T20:24Z] run=prf-422 p95=330ms kv_miss=5.9% (after prefetch+window). CSV: https://perf.redwood/runs/prf-422.csv

Diego (Presales): Draft pilot pricing uploaded: https://pricing.redwood/drafts/auroraedge-30d. Two options: 30-day hosted pilot, or 30-day hosted with convertible credit to a 12mo reserved commit. Will refine for bridge.

Hugo (Legal): DPA addendum template for pilot uploaded: https://legal.redwood/drafts/auroraedge-dpa. If BYO-HSM required, call it out in the bridge.

Nora (AE): Sending invite with one-liner + artifacts. Agenda: SRE shows canary, Security reviews SOC2/KMS + SSO steps, Presales presents pilot pricing, Legal outlines DPA timeline. Post-bridge note: if the bridge resolves, propose 30-day pilot with conversion credit.

BridgeBot: Reminder: BR-14921 starts in 10 minutes.

Nora (AE): Post-bridge summary: AuroraEdge CTO accepted the canary numbers and SSO plan. Procurement requested the written 30-day pilot quote and DPA; Diego and Hugo to deliver tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
